text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan has been hanging out with her new friends every day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing their words of support feels awkward to her, but also nice. She seems much more cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have a joint training session with Trainer Kiryuin, whose wordy explanations go over Jordan's head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm able to explain things in a way that's easier for her to digest, but she can't help but thinking…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "…If only I could understand all your strategies, maybe I'd be a stronger runner."
